items.uz: Ushbu masala bo'yicha murojaat qilmoqchi edim.
items.en: I wanted to make a petition regarding this matter.

items.uz: Arizangiz belgilangan tartibda ko'rib chiqiladi.
items.en: Your application will be reviewed in the established order.

items.uz: Qachon javob olishimiz mumkin?
items.en: When can we receive a response?

items.uz: Ikki hafta ichida javob berilishi kutilmoqda.
items.en: A response is expected to be given within two weeks.

items.uz: Qanday hujjatlar taqdim etilishi kerak?
items.en: What documents need to be submitted?

items.uz: Pasport nusxasi va ariza ilova qilinishi lozim.
items.en: A copy of the passport and the application need to be attached.

items.uz: Rahmat, hammasini tayyorlab kelaman.
items.en: Thank you, I'll prepare everything and come.

items.uz: Yana savolingiz bo'lsa, murojaat qilishingiz mumkin.
items.en: If you have any more questions, you may contact us.

items.uz: Vaqt ajratganingiz uchun tashakkur bildiraman.
items.en: I express my gratitude for the time you've given.

items.uz: Xizmatingiz uchun rahmat.
items.en: Thank you for your service.

items.uz: Kerakli hujjatlar shu yerda ekan.
items.en: It turns out the necessary documents are right here.

items.uz: Unda hammasi tartibda.
items.en: Then everything is in order.

items.uz: Hayot yo'lida achchiq-u shirin kunlar bo'ladi.
items.en: In life's journey, there are bitter and sweet days.

items.uz: Kechayu kunduz mehnat qilgan odam natijaga erishadi.
items.en: A person who works day and night achieves results.

items.uz: U aslida juda dono ekan.
items.en: It turns out he/she is actually very wise.

items.uz: Boshqalar tashvish qilgani bilan, u xotirjam edi.
items.en: Despite others worrying, he/she was calm.

items.uz: Men sabr haqida gapiraman, u esa umid haqida.
items.en: I speak of patience, whereas he/she speaks of hope.

items.uz: Har bir sinov ortidan yangi saboq keladi.
items.en: Behind every trial comes a new lesson.

items.uz: Kelgach, hammasi o'z holicha yechim topadi.
items.en: As soon as [the time] comes, everything finds its own solution.

items.uz: Aql yoshda emas, boshda, deyishadi bekorga emas.
items.en: They don't say "wisdom isn't in age, it's in the mind" for nothing.

items.uz: Ba'zan sukut so'zdan ko'ra ko'proq narsani anglatadi.
items.en: Sometimes silence conveys more than words.

items.uz: Har kim o'z yo'lini o'zi tanlaydi.
items.en: Everyone chooses their own path.

items.uz: Vaqt hammasini o'z joyiga qo'yadi.
items.en: Time puts everything in its place.

items.uz: Shu bois, sabr-toqatni yo'qotmaslik kerak.
items.en: For this reason, one must not lose patience.
